resources.string: Review and close interrupted file sharing

Review this app and file yourself. Only a verified private copy, up to 8 MiB, can be shared. Choose the recipient in Android’s chooser. The recipient may copy the file or send it to a remote service or another person. Jarvys cannot recall copies or confirm delivery. Automated device access remains blocked until you explicitly acknowledge closing the chooser and recipient task.
Checking the requesting app and complete file. No sharing has been authorized.
I closed the chooser and recipient task; acknowledge and close

Close the chooser and recipient app task yourself before acknowledging below. A chooser callback does not prove they closed or that the file was delivered. Acknowledgment revokes further access and removes the private copy; copies already made cannot be recalled.
